episodes.title: The Initiative
episodes.summary: At the Valley Forge Auto shop, manager Will pushes a new inclusion initiative and invites a reporter to cover it, but the interview goes off the rails.

episodes.title: Windows of Opportunity
episodes.summary: With sales down, Dave pressures Will to send a mechanic to another shop. Meanwhile, Shane reconnects with an old friend who proposes a tempting offer.

episodes.title: Sales Contest
episodes.summary: To beat Belmont's team in sales and win a gift card, the shop draws in customers with an oil change special, but Will's upselling attempts fall short.

episodes.title: The Rumor Mill
episodes.summary: Will tries to build a marketing campaign for his new idea — until devastating rumors about the store's future and his reputation throw him off-balance.

episodes.title: Bikini Car Wash
episodes.summary: Will and Shane prepare for a fun day on the job after hiring women for an attention-grabbing car wash but are forced to pivot when a visitor drops in.

episodes.title: Dad
episodes.summary: Will hits a low point after clashing with his toughest critic over his life choices. An unlikely advocate steps in to help save his job — and the shop.

episodes.title: Bonus Money
episodes.summary: With business booming and morale high, Will seeks to expand Valley Forge's reach. Shane's questionable new purchase causes chaos at the shop.

episodes.title: HR
episodes.summary: A mandatory HR training becomes a trainwreck when Shane hijacks the curriculum and an unwanted visitor crashes the course.

episodes.title: Inspection
episodes.summary: When an inspection uncovers a health hazard in the garage, the crew goes into a tailspin. Will witnesses an image that cannot be unseen.

episodes.title: Shiny New Thing
episodes.summary: While rocking a new look, Will finds surprising common ground with a rookie sales rep. A contentious lunch with a relative resurfaces grudges for Shane.

episodes.title: Record High
episodes.summary: The search for a new manager takes a turn when Will hires a candidate who shatters sales records — and raises red flags.

episodes.title: The Tri-State Mid Market Tire Expo
episodes.summary: At a tire industry expo, Will rolls the dice on a risky business proposition, while Shane hustles for tickets to a sold-out event.

episodes.title: Free Fries
episodes.summary: A secret meeting could change the game for Will — if day-drinking doesn't tank it. Shane wrangles two teens into getting their hands dirty at the shop.

episodes.title: Retirement
episodes.summary: A retirement celebration gets out of hand as Shane questions the company's vision and Dave's reckless behavior catches up with him.

episodes.title: The Radio Ad
episodes.summary: A radio commercial for the shop becomes a free-for-all when the station's morning hosts expose Will's past live on the air.

episodes.title: Patriots and Traitors
episodes.summary: At a triumphant relaunch party, Will and Shane's costumes steal the show. But a brewing crisis threatens to spoil the festivities.

episodes.title: Misery Has Company
episodes.summary: When the shop's sales plan takes an unexpected turn, the gang finds renewed purpose in the unlikely form of Shane's childhood hero.

episodes.title: At What Cost
episodes.summary: Facing a crossroads, the Valley Forge team must find a way forward as Will and Shane combine their strengths to snag a potential lifeline.

episodes.title: It Often Rhymes
episodes.summary: Will pitches a commercial to boost sales, but Phil counters with a more immediate way to cut costs. A familiar face on a dating app catches Shane's eye.

episodes.title: Secret Shopper
episodes.summary: After a mystery shopper exposes weaknesses across the Valley Forge chain, Dave seizes the opportunity to put Will and Shane's shop to the test.

episodes.title: Women's Business
episodes.summary: Hoping to make connections, Will brings Kilah to a women's networking event. Shane talks Cal into blowing off inventory for a night of nostalgic fun.

episodes.title: What's That Like
episodes.summary: As Will scrambles to repair his reputation, Shane's fitness kick leaves him feeling the burn. Dave joins Phil for a sales meeting with a toxic tire rep.

episodes.title: Wings
episodes.summary: A brush with mortality offers Shane an unsettling glimpse of his future. Will reunites with a former coworker whose success stirs up old regrets.

episodes.title: The Locked Room
episodes.summary: As Phil's relationship woes create headaches at work, Shane's love life shifts into a higher gear. Meanwhile, Pete presents Dave with a tempting offer.

episodes.title: Six of Swords
episodes.summary: To get back on Phil's good side, Will turns to Bonnie for spiritual guidance. Shane takes some newly acquired skills for a spin in the bedroom.

episodes.title: Volley
episodes.summary: While drinking with Cal, Kilah endures an awkward run-in with her high school teammates. A work dinner pushes Dave's self-control to the limit.

episodes.title: Dog's Out of the Fence
episodes.summary: Shane's love life hits a speed bump as things get complicated with Jill and Lucy. Will's mysterious absence from work throws a wrench into Dave's plans.

episodes.title: Tigers at the Circus
episodes.summary: Will explores a promising venture outside the shop. Shane and Dave look to seal the deal at a ride-and-drive with a questionable tire vendor.

episodes.title: Let's Just See
episodes.summary: Shane and Will are ready to lock in a major partnership, but Phil pumps the brakes on making any decisions until Bonnie works her healing magic.

episodes.title: It's a Good Day, West Chester
episodes.summary: While promoting Valley Forge's next chapter on a local morning TV show, Will and Shane confront life-changing news and uncertainty at the shop.
